qa.title: Q211 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: If the follower I selected with this follower's Fanfare ability leaves the field, does this follower's attack become 0?
qa.answer: No. The value added by this follower's Fanfare ability will not change, even if the selected follower leaves the field or has their attack value changed later.

qa.title: Q210 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: If the attack value of the follower I selected with this follower's Fanfare ability has been changed, does this follower's attack become the same value?
qa.answer: Yes. This follower gains attack equal to the selected follower's current attack value.

qa.title: Q209 (Jun. 30, 2023)
qa.question: Can I select a follower from any player's field with this follower's Fanfare ability?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.
